question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: times

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given words. 
 
 
• "Time" refers to the number of seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, years, decades, centuries, millennia and so on. This noun is uncountable.
 
• "Timing" is the measure of coincidence of events.
 
• "Timings" mean everything from the time of the commencement of an event, any breaks or recesses and the time of conclusion of the event.
 
• "Times" refers to the **number of occurrences**. The number of instances that something happened.
 
 
 
• In the question 'Covid-19 pandemic' is mentioned and we know that **Covid-19 had many waves, so there are multiple occurrences.**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 4.

Complete Paragraph: *The Covid-19 pandemic has deeply affected people across the world. During these difficult **(1)** **times __**frontline workers have been at the highest risk as (2)______ have been stepping out to work daily (3)______ proper protective gear. An NGO reached out to people to (4)______ funds to procure PPE kits, masks and sanitizers for (5)______ among the frontline workers. Several school children participated (6)______ this noble initiative. They collected old newspapers and books and (7)______ them to raise a good sum of money which was (8)______ used to buy kits. The children were happy to (9)______ and learnt how taking care of each other is very (10)______ in such challenging situations.*
